preconditions.expression: all(c in ('E', 'N') for c in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of characters 'E' or 'N'

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 1 + sum(1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Input starts with a single integer t (number of test cases), followed by exactly t non-empty strings

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string has length n where 2 ≤ n ≤ 50

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() == 'YES' or stdout.strip() == 'NO' for stdout in [line.strip() for line in output_lines])
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is either 'YES' or 'NO'

Output 'YES' if and only if there exists an assignment of positive integers a₁, ..., aₙ consistent with the equality/non-equality constraints in s, where test_cases are the input strings and any_possible_assignment(s) is true if such an assignment exists

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.strip()) == 3 for stdout in [line.strip() for line in output_lines])
postconditions.description: Each output line is exactly 3 characters ('YES' or 'NO')
